scope: Completed standalone zx-esxdos-rom target with reclaimed low RAM, tested and staged with user-updated xld. Stock esxDOS0.8.9 on emulated divIDE, with no Sinclair base ROM or application copy to RAM.

memory.firmware_workspace: Supported native file services keep their internal buffers/state in divIDE RAM. Caller buffers, stack and bounded ROM-input copies cost additional Spectrum RAM.

heap_repair.behavior: heap_init_arena now cleans its stacked limit argument as required by sdcccall(1); its assembly caller no longer cleans it twice. Existing allocator features retained.

additional_evidence_qualification: The eight memory traces and eight custom-2KiB-stack coldboots retain their preceding-tool identities. They are separate evidence, not counted among the67 current-tool coldboots. Historical compiler/benchmark campaign results remain in xip-validation-2026-09.json; the18047 compiler variants were not rerun for this platform finalization.
limits: Firmware0.8.9 with matching SYS files and AutoBoot=0.
Standalone48K target: BASIC services, dot commands, NMI browser and128K banking are outside the target contract.
Stack allowance is configurable application capacity, not an esxDOS minimum. Observed firmware stack depth is not a universal upper bound.
Tests use real firmware in ZEsarUX; physical hardware has not been exercised.
Distribution manifests and staged files checked; Debian archive not rebuilt.
